scope: Non-author review of root-authored common.py/cpu_audit.py/probe.py/resource_guard.py, frozen LETTER semantics, independent standard-library data/header counts and batch/Trainer arithmetic. No claim of executing GPU or approving a formal seed.
author_conflict_exclusion: Reviewer implemented setup_env.py/prepare_wheels.py/dependencies*.json; those environment implementations are NOT independently reviewed here.

source_binding.note: Bind to exact source SHA values; this review does not claim unpublished files belong to the earlier working-tree HEAD.

semantic_findings: Training prefixes exclude the final two interactions; each target uses the last at most 20 prior items, joined by comma+space, without numbering.

Training samples one of the 17 original SeqRec templates per access. Validation constructs two templates without replacement per user, then remains fixed. Test uses prompt0 and the final interaction target.

Original active modules_to_save train the complete embedding and output matrices; original_module clones are frozen. Tied Qwen input/output uses one active shared parameter, an explicit architecture adaptation from untied LLaMA.

Qwen collator retains exact original natural-language bytes, masks prompt and attention-mask padding, and asserts four target SID IDs plus real EOS. Attention-mask padding is required when PAD equals EOS.

Training CE is float32 full-vocabulary causal shift, logits divided by 0.8, ignore_index=-100 and mean reduction. Each checked sample has five supervised targets, so equal micro-batch means preserve the global sample weighting.

The original callback permits per-position sets, not a trie. Adapted callback binds the unchanged prompt end and context-aware Response delimiter, then returns positions 0/1/2/3 and EOS. No candidate filtering or beam reduction is introduced.

batch_and_loader.tail_note: No complete epoch is executed. Runtime loader class/length and tail behavior must remain distinguishable from arithmetic; formal step denominator must use actual loader.

gpu_static_findings.detail: requires_grad set is compared exactly to unique Trainer optimizer members and DeepSpeed bit16_groups. F explicitly enables all instantiated official text-model parameters; q35 L is blocked pending a meaningful authorized DeltaNet mapping.

Records pre-step LR, actual engine global_steps, Adam step values, finite gradients, SID input-activation and supervised-target-logit gradients, parameter changes and cross-rank hashes. Runtime values must actually pass.

Task-wide L<=12/F<=6 and each model L<=4/F<=2; rank0 precharges the global boundary before optimizer step. Existing attempts are consumed across jobs/precision/micro-batch retries; precharge on a failed step is conservatively counted.

One shared flock serializes probes. Sum of full child lifetime is charged for both devices including imports/load/errors/save/inference. Limits are 21600 device seconds/task,7200/model,<=2660 child wall seconds/job, with 30 seconds reserved from cumulative ceilings for polling/cleanup; unresolved old jobs prevent reset. Runtime cleanup and final ledger still require review.

CUDA synchronization, MAX rank duration, SUM nonpadding input tokens, padded tensor positions and supervised targets are distinct. Global64 timing includes collator/check/JSON/instrumentation overhead. F has only two updates and no stable repeated representative throughput series.

Both ranks snapshot all actual adapter trainable values, strict disk/loaded key and value checks, complete tokenizer vocab equality and tied identity; full optimizer-state restoration is explicitly NOT TESTED.

Eight fixed actual users, prompt0,20 beams/returns,<=10 new tokens; asserts four position-permitted SID IDs followed by EOS, finite sequence scores and actual callback calls. Canonical-fraction is recorded without forcing legal directory combinations.

Gradient evidence now separately tests actual input SID positions and supervised target SID logits despite tied shared gradients.
GPU budget reserves cleanup time, verifies tracked descendants after normal/error exits, and generation/save-reload memory peaks are reset by phase.
runtime_requirements_and_limits: No runtime PASS is issued by this static review; inspect raw requests, worker exits, source mapping, both ranks, resources and ledger after actual jobs.
Full-parameter two-update route cannot establish steady representative throughput. Report conditional budget and INCONCLUSIVE when key costs remain unknown.

Resource static 9*N per-card ZeRO2 persistence assumes BF16 gradients and partitioned FP32 master/moments. Verify actual optimizer and gradient dtypes/devices; static estimates are not measured peaks.

Parameter change snapshots use all SID rows and representative parameter slices; cross-rank hashes cover full LoRA tensors. Do not describe sliced change checks as full tensor element-by-element change checks.
Qwen3.5 official text-only class excludes source visual/MTP components; its full-parameter result applies to that instantiated text model only, not the complete multimodal checkpoint.
Beam rates include the first generation without a distinct extra warmup; extrapolation must state cold/representative-sample limits.
No complete checkpoint/optimizer/scheduler/RNG restore, formal four-epoch seed, best-checkpoint selection, full recommendation metric evaluation or Recall/NDCG quality conclusion is verified.
